content.comment_body: Hello! I am currently using [product_name] to control HVAC subsystems via LON bus, with integration to [product_name] PX. I searched the forum and the [company_name] portal, but haven’t found any details about the [product_name] CM Lon module or how to integrate it with [product_name] PX. Can anyone share guidance or experience?

I managed to get everything working. The key tools needed are [product_name] RXT [version_no], xWorks [version_no], MarlonTool, and [product_name] SoftComfort [version_no]. 1. Start a project in RXT, set the integration target to pxr11; 2. Add the slave device cm-lon, which should use xif v3; 3. Set up your bindings; 4. Connect and install the devices; 5. Use MarlonTool to create address listings; 6. Add the necessary blocks in xWorks; 7. Compile and download. If all steps are completed correctly, you should be able to read and write to the analog and digital inputs and outputs of [product_name]. -- [user_name]
Hello [user_name], thank you for sharing the solution. This information will certainly benefit others in the future. We hope you find value in the Technical Forum. Best regards, [user_name] Moderator
